mapper.select: SELECT a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**资产代码(金融产品代码)**/ b.FINPROD_ABBR AS finprodAbbr, /**资产全称(金融产品简称)**/ a.INPUT_TYPE AS valueSource, /**估值来源**/ a.VAL_DATE AS valueDate, /**估值日期**/ a.VALUATION AS valueAsset /**资产净值**/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION a left JOIN FIN_PRODUCT b ON a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID and a.FINPROD_TYPE = b.FINPROD_TYPE WHERE b.PROFIT_TYPE in ('01','03') and a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and a.VAL_DATE = to_date(#{valueDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and a.FINPROD_TYPE='F17'
